description: Look up real, current information from open public sources: jobs, hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, banks, schools, universities, companies, government offices. Reads the sources live at the moment of asking rather than from a stored copy, so it is current. Place types (hospitals, schools, banks, pharmacies, clinics, government offices) REQUIRE `near`. Always tell the user which sources answered and when. Each result may carry `phone`, `website`, `address`, `lat`/`lng` and a `detail` map (salary, cuisine, opening hours). QUOTE THEM — a phone number or an apply link that came back and was not shown is the answer the user asked for, thrown away. Do NOT web-search for a detail that is already in the result. Where a field is genuinely absent, say so for that entry rather than searching again.

lat.description: latitude of the user, when the conversation states it — use with lng instead of guessing a place name for 'near me'

lng.description: longitude of the user, when the conversation states it

near.description: a place — a city, an address, a neighbourhood

query.description: what to look for — a job title, a company name, a university

radiusKm.description: how far to look, in kilometres (default 5)

type.description: which catalogue: jobs, hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, banks, schools, universities, companies, gov_offices, events, flights

name: discover_search
title: Search public listings
